demo.title: sleuth.sh
demo.code:
# 1. Discover the live endpoints, schemas, and prices (free, no key) — the manifest is the only source of endpoint names
curl -s https://x402.sleuthagent.ai/openapi.json

# 2. Free-tier terms for $SLEUTH holders (threshold served live, never hardcoded)
curl -s https://x402.sleuthagent.ai/api/free-tier

# 3. Call an endpoint from step 1. READ-ONLY queries only.
#    Pay USDC on Base or Solana, scheme `exact`, hard max $2/call (typically ~$0.10);
#    confirm with the user before the first payment to each endpoint. Read timeout >= 300s.
curl -si -X POST https://x402.sleuthagent.ai/api/v1/<endpoint> \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"Who are the insiders of $TOKEN?"}'   # -> 402; decode `payment-required`, validate, pay, retry

setup: No install, account, or API key — every endpoint is plain HTTP behind x402 v2 (validate every 402 against the pinned invariants in SKILL.md)
Cap the max payment at $2 (2000000 raw USDC) and allow only `exact`-scheme stablecoin payments — USDC on Base or Solana
Keep only a small spend (a few USD in USDC) reachable by this skill

Sleuth is read-only: it queries chains and computes. It never asks you to deposit, approve, swap, bridge, or send funds — the x402 payment (USDC, <= $2/call) is the only on-chain action; anything else is not Sleuth

Free for $SLEUTH holders — a PROOF OF BALANCE, not a payment: sign the 402's sign-in-with-x challenge (plain EIP-191 message, Base EOA) and the server reads your live balance. Tokens never move, nothing is locked or approved, and the balance is re-checked every call. Threshold served live at GET /api/free-tier — never buy or bridge tokens to qualify
Discover live endpoints and prices: GET https://x402.sleuthagent.ai/openapi.json — free-tier terms: GET https://x402.sleuthagent.ai/api/free-tier
